invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null JsonValue (either parent, template, or a newly created merged object).

invariants.expression: (template == null && result == parent) || (parent == null && result == template) || (template != null && parent != null && result != template && result != parent)
invariants.rationale: Result is parent if template is null, template if parent is null, otherwise a new merged object not equal to either.
The returned JsonValue has a detached tree (parent is null) as per Javadoc.
If template is not null, code expects it to be an object (for iteration and property access).
If parent is not null, code expects it to be an object (for iteration and property access).
